xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5232: Herdr pane reads always return empty text: readers use result.text, herdr 0.9.1 returns result.read.text

plan.title: Herdr pane reads always return empty text: readers use result.text, herdr 0.9.1 returns result.read.text
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: HerdrApiClient.call() returns the response result unchanged. Herdr 0.9.1 answers pane.read with {type:'pane_read', read:{text,...}}, but three readers take result.text: readHerdrPaneText and diagnoseDetectionFailure in herdr.ts, and the composer read in herdr-submit.ts. Every Herdr pane read is therefore '', and readiness waits, crash/stall checks, resume-menu handling, input-target checks, API-error nudges and submit verification are blind. Every unit test mocks the wrong {text} shape, so the suite stayed green.
narratives.Proposal: Add one import-free parser, herdrPaneReadText (src/lib/terminal-backends/herdr-pane-read.ts), that reads result.read.text, accepts legacy result.text, and returns '' with one warning otherwise. Route all three readers through it, convert every wire-level pane.read mock to the 0.9.1 shape, pin the exact 0.9.1 response with a contract test through the real HerdrApiClient and the schema fixture, document the wire shape plus the audit of every other result key (all others verified correct live and against the schema), and record read-only live evidence plus the list of behaviour that was degraded.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing HerdrApiClient.call() to unwrap results
- Changing any screen parser (composer, agent selector, resume gate, readiness regexes, API-error patterns); bugs that real text exposes become follow-up issues (W3's Step 3 guard and W7's guard check reuse paneHasBlockingChoiceMenu and change no parser)
- Sending text or keys to any operator pane during verification
- Upgrading Herdr, pinning another version, or regenerating the schema fixture
- Raising the herdr.ts row in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt
- Any change to the tmux backend path
- Adding the guard-mode menu check to the tmux resume branch

autoDecisions.summary: Fix diagnoseDetectionFailure's pane.read too, though the issue lists only two readers
autoDecisions.rationale: It has the identical result.text bug (herdr.ts ~line 718); requirement 1 says every reader uses the shared parser.

autoDecisions.summary: An unrecognized pane.read shape returns '' and warns once per process instead of throwing
autoDecisions.rationale: '' is the behaviour every caller already tolerates; a throw would make ensureMainInputTarget refuse every Claude delivery and block every autonomous resume on a future shape change. The contract test makes a shape change fail CI.

autoDecisions.summary: Convert every wire-level pane.read test mock to the 0.9.1 shape; only the parser unit test covers the legacy shape
autoDecisions.rationale: The wrong-shape mocks are what hid this bug; leaving them green through the legacy fallback would keep tests describing a wire Herdr does not speak.

autoDecisions.summary: Live check = a required read-only run (readHerdrPaneText plus waitForClaudeReady on an existing idle conversation) plus a required attempt at an isolated-instance Claude launch, with the read-only run as the stated fallback
autoDecisions.rationale: Requirement 4 asks for a launch reaching readiness; only a cold launch exercises the dialog and early-exit paths. A work agent cannot deploy to or paste into the operator's live dashboard, but the PAN-5122 isolated-instance recipe is proven.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the parser in a new leaf module rather than in herdr.ts or herdr-api.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: herdr-submit.ts must not import herdr-api.ts (import cycle through types.ts), and herdr.ts sits 2 lines under its file-size cap.

autoDecisions.summary: Adopt both plan-critic blocking findings: herdr-submit Step 3 checks blocked/menu before the first Enter whatever the paste presence, and the Herdr resume path refuses guard-mode menus and reads visible
autoDecisions.rationale: Making reads work would otherwise skip the blocked check that every delivery gets today and press Enter into a permission menu, contradicting herdr-submit.ts's own header; the resume path would type a continuation into a permission menu the card parser drops.

items.title: Add the herdrPaneReadText parser module with unit tests

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5232.md work item W1 and decisions D1-D3. Create src/lib/terminal-backends/herdr-pane-read.ts exporting herdrPaneReadText(result: unknown): string, using the exact code in W1. The module imports nothing (herdr-submit.ts must not import herdr-api.ts: import cycle through types.ts). Precedence: result.read.text if it is a string, else result.text if it is a string, else '' plus one console.warn per process with the message in D3 (contains 'PAN-5232' and the top-level keys). Never throw. Write the six unit cases listed in W1 in tests/unit/lib/terminal-backends/herdr-pane-read.test.ts.

narrative.Action: PRD W4 and D5. New test file. Build a fake connect factory for HerdrApiClient (pattern: FakeSocket in tests/unit/lib/terminal-backends/herdr-api.test.ts): each connection emits 'connect' on the next tick, parses the written request, and feeds the canned response for that method with id set to the request id. Use the exact canned pane.read line from W4 (full 0.9.1 key set, synthetic text). Case 1: readHerdrPaneText('w2:p7C', 1, 'recent', client) resolves to the canned text. Case 2: pasteAndSubmitHerdrPane(client, 'w2:p7C', 'hello world', 'enter', {sleep, now}) with an injected fake clock returns 'submitted' (screen shows 'hello world' between two ─ rule rows until pane.send_keys arrives, then an empty composer; agent.get answers agent_status idle). Case 3: load the schema fixture src/lib/terminal-backends/__fixtures__/herdr-v0.9.1/schema.json and assert the pane_read ResponseResult variant's non-type properties are exactly ['read'], read.$ref ends with '/PaneReadResult', and PaneReadResult.required contains 'text'. No real socket, no real delays, no reading of source files. Case 1 also calls client.call('pane.read', ...) directly and asserts result.text is undefined and result.read.text equals the canned text.
